name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
description: Unilateral pullover allowing greater stretch and fixing left-right lat imbalances.
setup: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell extended over chest in one hand.
execution: Arc the dumbbell back until lat stretches, sweep it back overhead.
breathing: Inhale on stretch, exhale on pull
progression: More load or slower stretch phase

name: Dumbbell Yates Row
description: Underhand grip row targeting lower lats for V-taper width.
setup: Hinge forward about 45 degrees, palms facing forward underhand grip.
execution: Row dumbbells to lower abs, squeezing lats, lower with control.
breathing: Exhale on row, inhale on lower
progression: Heavier weight or pause at contraction

name: Dumbbell Pullover to Press
description: Combination pullover and press hitting lats and chest through full range.
setup: Lie across bench holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
execution: Lower dumbbell behind head for pullover, bring back over chest, press up.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on press
